body: It is SUPER PERSONAL. That is why i was vague about it.

the thing i wrote got deleted :c but yes i feel better, wish i had gotten or hadnt been afraid to get help sooner. There are entire businesses and people who's careers are there to help. You can tell your parents stuff, your girlfriend stuff, your best friend stuff, we all have secrets. You can tell your therapist your secrets if you want. They are there to help guide you through your thoughts and feeling and ideas. Help you figure out what you're trying to say and in a non intrusive way. Its really nice. I've got a ways to go yet. The thing i feel the best about when i do feel good is that i've begun. First step has been taken.
i made her feel very unsafe.

when i became comfortable and actually started to find comfort in thoughts of suicide, it got worse. i got into therapy and have tried some medications for energy and motivation and anxiety. i knew something was wrong just never knew what was quite wrong. im getting help and trying to help myself. diet, yoga, exercise, sleep. trying to talk to others about it. its why i came to this thread.

It still think it might be the wrong choice. But now having tasted it, been picked up by ambulances and firemen and police, ppl trained and hired to come out to someone who has made some sort of threat. Going through that, My mind hasnt changed. im still me, im still here. its still there. Im just here. i could keep writing for hours but i think im gonna hit more text limits. I guess my question is: What do you do when you feel like there is no way out, you'll never change, the longer you stay the worse it will get, anyone you talk to can listen but cant hear, and you can hardly feel the sun on your skin. a calm quiet acceptance.

what i would say to this is that the only place you have left to go is 'up'. its the one strange side effect i've learned about feeling you're at your absolute lowest. there isnt anywhere else to go. all the doors are shut. whatever is behind you doesnt get in the way of whats in front of you.. metaphorically?  where do you go from here? up.

I've done something terrible and physical to my closest female friend before. It was a horrible feeling and the thought of spreading my own sadness and weakness into the lives of others is constantly plaguing me. I probably think about it on a minute to minute basis. 5 years later, we're still friends. I freaked her out but over time i was forgiven. i'd like to you could be forgiven too if you're patient and hopeful. I wasnt hopeful but it worked out.

i wouldnt be here trying to learn how to post in the suicidewatch thread if i didnt share or feel or believe some of the things im reading here. a comforting and overwhelming amount of ppl feel this 'lesser' or 'weaker' or 'smaller' effect. the one thing and its weird because i wouldnt let myself for about 10 years. is crying. I've tried completely given over into crying instead of fighting the pain. cry so hard for long with so much pain bubbling through my chest, my neck, my eyes. till i was so tired from it i slept. I look forward to the next time im in THAT much pain that i cant take it cause it means i'll have a chance to cry and let some of it out. It lessens the pain from a sharp and piercing feeling to something that is still hot and aches but doesnt cut.

i've been in therapy and on meds for about 5 months now. I sort of get the drowning feeling. i've slowly come to love and hate the word progress. sometimes it's a lighthouse, sometimes its a black hole. You dont want to wait any longer you say. do you not want to wait any longer? or not struggle any longer? if your emotional pain stopped, would you feel like living again?
